claim: SnapStart charges for caching a snapshot while the function version is active, for a minimum of 3 hours and per millisecond after that, plus a charge each time Lambda restores the snapshot; this SnapStart pricing does not apply to supported Java managed runtimes.

values.display: does not apply to supported Java managed runtimes

qualifiers.condition: not for supported Java managed runtimes

evidence.quote: You are charged for caching a snapshot over the period that your function version is active, for a minimum of 3 hours and per millisecond thereafter. The price depends on the amount of memory you allocate to your function. You are also charged each time Lambda resumes an execution environment by restoring your snapshot, with the price depending on the amount of memory you allocate to your function.
SnapStart pricing does not apply to supported Java managed runtimes.
